Command-Line Reference > sa sla test

sa sla test

sa sla test compiles a .sla test file, then hands it to the host sa test to run. The default backend auto lands on the SA text path (the production path); SAB requires an explicit --test-backend sab (opt-in, SAB is sealed). After reading this page you can select the compilation backend, filter tests by name, and know where the test artifacts land.

Syntax

usage: sa sla test [file] [-p <package>] [--test-backend auto|sab|sa] [sa-test-options...]

Parameters

NameDescription
fileThe .sla source file containing the tests; when omitted, the member entry point is resolved via the workspace.
-p, --packageSelect the workspace member package.
--test-backend auto|sab|saSelect the test compilation backend. The default auto lands on the SA text path (the production path), and sa takes the same path; sab explicitly specifies SAB (a sealed optimization direction, opt-in). The equals form --test-backend=sab is also accepted. This is the only backend-selection spelling in the whole command set, and the build-exe family recognizes it too.
--filter <name>Run only tests whose names match; it also determines the filter-scoped cache path of the managed artifact and does not overwrite the artifacts of a full test run. The equals form --filter=name is also supported.
--emit-sabAdditionally write a sibling .sab next to the source file.
Remaining argumentsPassed through to the delegated sa test (such as --trace-panic, --skip, --list); --test-backend and --filter are consumed by the plugin and then stripped. --jobs auto is appended automatically by default.
-h, --helpShow usage and return 0.
NoteIf the filter selects no tests at all, the command does not start a child process; it directly outputs an empty passing result (0 passed; 0 failed; 0 skipped) and returns 0.

Examples

# 默认 auto 后端（SA 文本路，生产路径）
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test tests/test_unit_basic.sla

# 明确指定 SAB 后端（显式 opt-in）
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test lib/parallel.sla --test-backend sab

# 显式指定文本后端（与默认同路）
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test tests/test_unit_basic.sla --test-backend sa

# 只跑匹配的测试并保留 panic 追踪
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test src/main.sla --filter vec_basics --trace-panic

# Rosetta demo
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa sla test demos/rosetta/01_hello_world/main.sla

Output locations

  • SAB backend (sab only): the managed artifact is in .sla-cache/sab/<stem>-<hash>.sab; with --filter, the filter value is additionally mixed into the hash to form an independent variant path; it neither generates nor overwrites the SAB artifacts of ordinary build/workspace.
  • SA text backend (auto/sa, the default): writes a sibling <stem>.test.sa next to the source file, deleted by default after the run finishes; setting the environment variable SLA_KEEP_TEST_SA keeps it for inspection.
  • The exit code is taken from the return value of the delegated sa test.
